title: Chapter 375: Humble And Polite Lin Zhu
content:
Chapter 375: Humble And Polite Lin Zhu

After a while, Wang Shuo's second battle began.

This time, the opponent was obviously much stronger, with 3 generals and 10 high-level generals.

However, the number of intermediate and primary generals was much less than Wang Shuo's.

I don't know whether it was because they were not replenished or lost in the previous battle.

"Your Excellency is polite, I am Lin Zhu."

Wang Shuo saw that the other party was so polite, after all, they were friendly troops, so he greeted them: "I am Wang Shuo, please."

"Please."

Both sides set up their positions and prepared to launch an attack.

This duel was a completely fair battle, which surprised Wang Shuo a little. He had never encountered such a reasonable opponent.

The earth dragon beast dug the soil with its hooves, ready to charge at any time.

"Attack."

At Wang Shuo's command, the earth dragon beast rushed out quickly, and Wang Shuo took the lead, sitting on the back of Da Huang, rushing to the front.

Lin Zhu's troops were not ordinary troops either. Their mounts were a ferocious lion monster.

The strength of the dragon beast is comparable to that of the earth dragon beast.

The two sides engaged in a fierce melee.

The duel between the monsters, coupled with the duel between the warriors on the backs of the monsters, instantly brought the battle to a white-hot stage.

Wang Shuo and Lin Zhu fought together.

Both of them were cavalrymen, and there was no fancy moves in the battle.

Wang Shuo used a move of "transforming into a dragon" to test the strength of his opponent.

Lin Zhu was not to be outdone and retaliated with a move of "splitting mountains and opening rocks".

The attacks of the two created a strong explosion in mid-air.

When they passed each other, Wang Shuo turned around and used a move of "dragon out of the sea".

Lin Zhu was shocked and had to raise his weapon to resist, but the dragon-shaped internal energy still hit him, and he immediately vomited blood.

In the first round of the confrontation between the two sides, Wang Shuo won.

However, Zhu Tianguo's battle did not achieve any results, and the strength of the two was only comparable.

Wang Shuo turned around and killed Lin Zhu again.

This time, the collision was more intense than the first one. Wang Shuo risked his injury and severely injured Lin Zhu.

Even though he was knocked off his mount, Lin Zhu did not admit defeat.

Wang Shuo quite agreed with this behavior.

He decided to give his opponent a quick death.

Returning again, Wang Shuo directly used "Iron Chain Binding" and added a move "Flying Dragon in the Sky" to end Lin Zhu's life.

Lin Zhu immediately resurrected in the audience. Seeing that he had already lost, Lin Zhu directly announced his surrender.

If he was unwilling, he could still choose to continue to consume the opponent's living strength. Although his remaining generals had no possibility of turning the tables, they could minimize the opponent's strength and reduce the number of generals participating in the next competition.

But Lin Zhu did not do so.

This kind of behavior that harms others and does not benefit oneself will make others look down on him, and may even lead to isolation and helplessness in subsequent battles.

Wang Shuo also returned to the audience and clasped his fists to the upright Lin Zhu.

Lin Zhu also returned the greeting, and everyone continued to watch the competition of other participating teams.

After two rounds of fighting, Wang Shuo noticed several teams with great potential.

One was Zhang Ren's shield and sword guards, whose defense was excellent.

One was Ma Kai's crossbow battalion. Although he was defeated in the second round, it was entirely due to the restraint of the troops.

There was also Tian Liang's cavalry unit. The mount he chose was the same as Wang Shuo's, the earth dragon beast.

It was a powerful force.
